messages:
Rae: Anyone doing anything this weekend? Thinking about a long walk + coffee crawl Saturday morning. :walking: :coffee:
Liam: I'm in for a walk. What route?
Noor: If it's a coffee crawl, I'm sold. Any indie spots on the list?
Rae: Was thinking River Trail -> Old Mill -> stop at Ember Roasters around 10am. Ember has new oat-milk cortados.
Liam: Ember works. Can join at 9:30 for the trail loop.
Noor: 10am at Ember for me (have a brunch thing earlier). Ping if you change spots.
Ping-Bot: FYI: public meetups should add an approximate guest count. Click to RSVP: tiny.redwood.social/rsvp
Rae: Cool, looks like 2 confirmed early, 1 later. I'll post a meeting pin tomorrow morning.
Liam: Also happy to bring a small pack of granola bars.
Noor: I'll swing by Ember and grab a table. See you Saturday!
Rae: OK see you all Saturday morning :)
